schema.description:

            existing user application session.

schema.description:

          empty, a full desktop session is started).
        - For protocol "REMOTE-APP": the alias of the RemoteApp (required).
        - For protocol "HTTP": the URL to the web application (required); when
          source_host_header is set, changing this value triggers a limited
          apply changes on the proxy service.

schema.title: Concurrent usage
schema.description:
Whether or not a user is allowed to open multiple instances of this
        application simultaneously. Cannot be disabled when protocol is
        "HTTP".

schema.title: Categories
schema.description: List of names of categories this app belongs to.

schema.title: Description
schema.description: Description of the application (not shown to the end-user).

schema.title: Domain
schema.description: Domain this application belongs to.

schema.title: Icon
schema.description: The URI of the app-icon.

schema.title: Labels
schema.description: List with labels in the format key:value that are assigned to this app. These can be used for organizational purposes or to activate certain features such as smartcard support (by adding the "smartcard:" label) or recording ("record:" label).

schema.title: File types
schema.description: List of file extensions (e.g. ["doc", "docx"]).

schema.title: Name
schema.description: Name of the application.

schema.title: Notifications enabled
schema.description: Enables all application notifications.

schema.title: Protocol
schema.description:
Protocol of the application. Possible options are:
        HTTP, RDP or REMOTE-APP.

schema.title: Working folder
schema.description:
Working folder into which the application needs to be launched. Only
        relevant when protocol is "RDP"

schema.title: Show in applications
schema.description: Whether or not to show this application on the Workspace.

schema.title: Server labels
schema.description: List with server labels in the format key:value that are assigned to this app. The app will be started on an appserver that also has one of these labels assigned.

schema.title: Start in foreground
schema.description:
When this application is configured to start automatically at login,
        "start_in_foreground" will make it run in the foreground. Only one
        application per domain can be configured to start in foreground.
        Cannot be enabled when protocol is "HTTP".

schema.title: Supports unicode kbd
schema.description:
Whether or not the application supports unicode keyboards, which are
        better in recognizing special characters. Disable this if typing in the
        application results in odd behavior (like repetition of the first typed
        character).

schema.title: Source host header
schema.description:
Setting this field will enable the Workspace to reverse proxy this
        URL mentioned in the command field. This the hostname shown to the
        user when opening this HTTP application in their browser
        (e.g. intranet-pub.mycompany.com). The host header should resolve
        via DNS to the Workspace, but should be different than the
        one(s) used to access the Workspace. Triggers a limited
        apply changes on the proxy service. Only relevant when protocol
        is "HTTP".

schema.title: Custom destination host header
schema.description:
When use_default_destination_host_header is disabled, the provided
        host header is passed to the server hosting the HTTP application.
        A typical use case is to enter the same value of the
        source_host_header, which means that the server hosting the HTTP
        application is aware of the presence of a reverse proxy (which
        might be a configuration option of the HTTP application). Triggers a
        limited apply changes on the proxy service. Only relevant when
        protocol is "HTTP".

schema.title: Enable max size
schema.description: Enable maximum resolution for apps with protocol RDP or REMOTE-APP. When this is enabled the max_height and max_width fields are required.

schema.title: Enable min size
schema.description: Enable minimum resolution for apps with protocol RDP or REMOTE-APP. When this is enabled the min_height and min_width fields are required.

schema.title: Max width
schema.description: Maximum width for apps with protocol: RDP or REMOTE-APP

schema.title: Max height
schema.description: Maximum height for apps with protocol: RDP or REMOTE-APP

schema.title: Min height
schema.description: Minimum height for apps with protocol: RDP or REMOTE-APP

schema.title: Min width
schema.description: Minimum width for apps with protocol: RDP or REMOTE-APP

schema.title: Use default destination host header
schema.description:
If enabled, the host header passed to the server hosting the HTTP
        application, will be the host name extracted from the url in the
        command field. Triggers a limited apply changes on the proxy service.
        Only relevant when protocol is "HTTP".

schema.title: Rewrite
schema.description:
Whether to rewrite all URLs in the returned content (HTTP headers,
        cookies and text/html body) from the HTTP application by replacing the
        host of the (custom) destination_host_header with the specified
        source_host_header. Rewriting is typically needed when the server
        hosting the HTTP application is not aware that it is reachable through
        a reverse proxy. Triggers a limited apply changes on the proxy service.
        Only relevant when protocol is "HTTP".

schema.title: User labels
schema.description: List with user labels in the format key:value that are assigned to this app. When logging in, only users that match one of these labels will have access to this app.

schema.title: Printer driver name
schema.description:
Determines which printer driver is used when using '
                  'the redirected printer.

schema.title: Color depth
schema.description: Defines the color depth of the streamed application.

schema.title: Reverse proxy http protocol version
schema.description: Defines the HTTP protocol version to use when communicating with the destination server.

schema.title: Reverse proxy ssl server name
schema.description:
If enabled, we will use Server Name Indication (SNI) when contacting the destination server
        over HTTPS. Only relevant when protocol is "HTTP" and the destination url starts with
        "https://".

schema.title: Reverse proxy sso enabled
schema.description:
If enabled, an HTTP header set by "reverse_proxy_sso_type" field
        will be passed to the server hosting the HTTP application, enabling SSO
        for web applications supporting Basic Auth/Remote User.
        Only relevant when protocol is "HTTP".

schema.title: Reverse proxy sso type
schema.description:
Type of reverse proxy sso to use. BASIC_AUTH adds
           Authentication header while REMOTE_USER
           adds REMOTE_USER header.
           Only relevant when protocol is "HTTP".

schema.title: Reverse proxy sso username type
schema.description:
Format of username that is set in the HTTP header
            for authentication during SSO.
            Only relevant when protocol is "HTTP".

schema.title: Context labels
schema.description: List with context policies in the format key:value that are assigned to this app. Only users that have a context that matches all of these labels will have access to this app.

        and EXTERNAL.
